en: A vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a panoramic view of a European river city with mountains in the background. Several bridges cross the river, lined by historic multi‑story buildings and tree-lined embankments. On the right stands a church with a bulbous Baroque bell tower, and above it on a hill is a fortress-like complex. Printed caption text at the bottom reads "GRAZ. STEIERMARK." and a small number "1607." appears at the lower left. At the lower right is the publisher credit "ERIKA-VERLAG." Additional building-side advertisements are faintly visible in German.
